unsubscribe.title: Stop match emails
unsubscribe.lead: Pemby stops sending matches to this address. Nothing else changes: your profile stays, your Brief stays, and Telegram and web push carry on if you have them on.
unsubscribe.done: Done. No more match emails to this address.
unsubscribe.doneLead: Turn them back on whenever you like, in your delivery settings.
unsubscribe.failed: That didn't go through. Press the button again.
unsubscribe.expiredLead: Links in an email stop working after a while. Open your delivery settings and turn match emails off there.

flag.title: Report a post
flag.lead: What you pick goes to Pemby, never to the company.
flag.details: If a detail is simply wrong — the pay, the level, the location — report it from your Brief, where you can say which one.
flag.already: You have already reported this post.
flag.failed: That didn't go through. Open your Brief and report it there.
flag.expiredLead: Links in an email stop working after a while. You can still report the post from your Brief.
